principals.name: Marta Vale
principals.opening: Bram has my shipment tied up at the docks. Help me before evening, and I won't forget it.

principals.name: Elias Ward
principals.opening: Greyhaven keeps its own order. See that you don't disturb it.

principals.name: Father Orin
principals.opening: Words have a longer life than their speakers.

principals.name: Nessa Reed
principals.opening: The tide answers to nobody, least of all merchants.

principals.name: Bram Coyle
principals.opening: Triple is simply what urgency costs.

principals.name: Talia Fen
principals.opening: Most troubles improve when someone arrives before being asked.

principals.name: Pip Marr
principals.opening: You're the newcomer with the royal purse, aren't you? Or was it a royal warrant?

principals.name: Rhea Kest
principals.opening: Elections in three days. The town could use a fresh name—or a useful fool.

ambients.name: Jonas Pike
ambients.opening: Cargo tells you who owes whom, if you know how to count.

ambients.name: Mae Dorr
ambients.opening: A hand that helps before the rain is a hand I remember.

ambients.name: Oswin Bell
ambients.opening: Everyone wants tomorrow's bread on yesterday's credit.

ambients.name: Del Sayer
ambients.opening: The tide brings truth in eventually. Usually smelling worse.

ambients.name: Hettie Voss
ambients.opening: Rhea knows how to keep the market predictable.

ambients.name: Cal Moss
ambients.opening: I vote for whoever keeps customers walking this row.

ambients.name: Edda Grey
ambients.opening: New names make old promises very easily.

ambients.name: Will Harker
ambients.opening: Rhea has faults. At least we already know their price.

ambients.name: Fen Lark
ambients.opening: A mayor ought to know which end of a crate is heavy.

ambients.name: Lina Thread
ambients.opening: Reputation is only a seam. Pull it and see what holds.

ambients.name: Tob Rill
ambients.opening: Buy no speeches before you've heard the second telling.

ambients.name: Kit Wren
ambients.opening: I know who answers a knock and who lets a message freeze.

endings.title: The Town Turns
endings.summary: Greyhaven chooses the newcomer by a margin even Rhea cannot explain away.

endings.title: By One Voice
endings.summary: The final name is yours, carried over the line by the memories you changed.

endings.title: The Tied Bell
endings.summary: Rhea keeps the guildhouse. One changed mind would have changed the town.

endings.title: No Seconding Voice
endings.summary: Your candidacy ends as a story the tavern tells more loudly than your speech.

endings.title: The Story Unravels
endings.summary: The town compares your word with its memory and finds the seam.

endings.title: The Road Remembers
endings.summary: Greyhaven sends you back down the road under a chorus of every threat it kept.
